18.english_meaning: The percentage of the adult population that cannot read or write.
18.hindi_meaning: वयस्क असाक्षरता दर (वयस्क आबादी का वह प्रतिशत जो पढ़ना-लिखना नहीं जानता)
18.example: Reducing the adult illiteracy rate is a primary goal for educational development.

18.example: Norway frequently ranks at the top of the Human Development Index globally.

18.english_meaning: An index that measures the deprivations in basic human development within a country.
18.hindi_meaning: मानव गरीबी सूचकांक (किसी देश में बुनियादी मानव विकास की कमी को मापने का पैमाना)
18.example: The human poverty index reveals deprivations that the standard development index might miss.

18.english_meaning: Improved, polished, or made more precise through careful development.
18.hindi_meaning: परिष्कृत या बेहतर किया हुआ (जिसे और अधिक सटीक बनाया गया हो)
18.example: The methods to measure progress are constantly being refined by researchers.

18.english_meaning: Dishonest or fraudulent conduct by those in power, typically involving bribery.
18.hindi_meaning: भ्रष्टाचार (सत्ता में बैठे लोगों द्वारा बेईमानी या रिश्वतखोरी करना)
18.example: Researchers study the link between the level of corruption and human development.

18.english_meaning: The right and freedom of citizens to participate freely in the political life of their society.
18.hindi_meaning: राजनीतिक स्वतंत्रता (नागरिकों को राजनीतिक प्रक्रियाओं में भाग लेने की आज़ादी)
18.example: Political freedom is an essential element for a democratic society.

18.english_meaning: A planned series of future events, items, or institutional operations.
18.hindi_meaning: कार्यक्रम या योजना (संगठित रूप से चलाई जाने वाली योजना)
18.example: The United Nations Development Programme publishes annual reports.

18.english_meaning: A philosophy and index that measures the collective happiness and well-being of a population rather than just economic growth.
18.hindi_meaning: सकल राष्ट्रीय प्रसन्नता (आर्थिक विकास के साथ-साथ नागरिकों की खुशी और कल्याण मापने का भूटान का पैमाना)
18.example: Bhutan officially adopted Gross National Happiness as a measure of progress.

18.english_meaning: Relating to or affecting the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.
18.hindi_meaning: आध्यात्मिक (भौतिक चीजों से परे आंतरिक और मानसिक शांति से संबंधित)
18.example: GNH encourages a balance between material and spiritual development.

18.english_meaning: Relating to the nature or standard of something rather than its quantity.
18.hindi_meaning: गुणात्मक (मात्रा के बजाय किसी वस्तु के गुण, स्तर या गुणवत्ता से संबंधित)
18.example: We must focus on the qualitative aspects of education, not just school enrollment numbers.

18.english_meaning: The average income earned by a person in a given area in a specified year.
18.hindi_meaning: प्रति व्यक्ति आय (किसी देश या क्षेत्र में प्रति व्यक्ति औसत कमाई)
18.example: Per capita income alone does not guarantee a high level of human development.

18.english_meaning: An area of land under the jurisdiction of a ruler or state.
18.hindi_meaning: क्षेत्र या भूभाग (किसी देश या राज्य के अधिकार क्षेत्र में आने वाली भूमि)
18.example: The size of the territory is not directly related to its human development score.

18.english_meaning: Arranged in categories according to shared qualities or characteristics.
18.hindi_meaning: वर्गीकृत (समान गुणों के आधार पर समूहों में विभाजित किया गया)
18.example: Countries can be classified into four groups based on their human development scores.

18.english_meaning: A principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.
18.hindi_meaning: मानदंड या कसौटी (वह आधार जिस पर किसी चीज़ का मूल्यांकन किया जाता है)
18.example: The criteria for the very high human development category require a score above 0.800.

18.english_meaning: To announce officially or publicly.
18.hindi_meaning: घोषणा करना (किसी बात को आधिकारिक रूप से जनता के सामने कहना)
18.example: Bhutan was the first country to proclaim GNH as its official progress indicator.

18.english_meaning: In a way that deliberately avoids potential problems or dangers.
18.hindi_meaning: सावधानीपूर्वक (सतर्कता के साथ ताकि कोई नुकसान न हो)
18.example: Material progress must be approached cautiously to protect the environment.

18.english_meaning: The damaging lack of material benefits considered to be basic necessities in a society.
18.hindi_meaning: वंचना या अभाव (बुनियादी सुविधाओं या आवश्यकताओं की कमी)
18.example: The human poverty index measures the severe deprivation faced by vulnerable populations.

18.english_meaning: Made up of various separate parts or elements.
18.hindi_meaning: मिश्रित या संयुक्त (कई अलग-अलग तत्वों से मिलकर बना हुआ)
18.example: The Human Development Index is a composite measure combining health, education, and income.

19.english_meaning: Countries or areas under the full or partial political control of another country.

19.english_meaning: Former; previous.

19.english_meaning: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people.

19.english_meaning: The state of being diverse; variety, especially in cultural or ethnic terms.

19.english_meaning: The state of being unstable; lack of stability or firmness.

19.english_meaning: Acts of resistance or rebellion; revolts.

19.english_meaning: An alphabetical list of names, subjects, etc., or a numerical scale used to compare data.

19.english_meaning: The action or process of investing money or resources for profit or material result.

19.english_meaning: The action or manner of governing a state, organization, or-set of people.

19.english_meaning: A return to a normal state of health, strength, or economic stability.

19.english_meaning: The fact or condition of being regarded or treated as more important than others.

19.english_meaning: Relating to society or its organization.

19.english_meaning: Positions in a scale or hierarchy.

20.english_meaning: A part or element of a larger whole, especially a system or organization.

20.english_meaning: An alphabetical list of names, subjects, etc., or a numerical scale used to compare data.

20.english_meaning: The quality of being fair and impartial; ensuring equal access to opportunities.

20.english_meaning: The ability to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting natural resources.

20.english_meaning: A state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty.

20.english_meaning: The state of being unstable; lack of stability or firmness.

20.english_meaning: The surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.

20.english_meaning: Fair and impartial; treating everyone equally.

20.english_meaning: Cause a process or action to begin.

20.english_meaning: Happening more quickly than normal; increased in rate or speed.
20.example: Accelerated economic growth helps lift people out of poverty.

21.english_meaning: The process of enlarging people's choices and improving their well-being, health, and education.
21.example: Human development focuses on improving the overall quality of human life rather than just economic growth.

21.english_meaning: Gu dishonest or fraudulent conduct by those in power, typically involving bribery.

21.english_meaning: Nations with their own government, occupying a particular territory.
21.example: Different countries have different policies regarding public welfare and education.

21.english_meaning: The number of points, marks, or numerical values obtained in a test or index.
21.example: Her test scores improved significantly after she started studying regularly.

21.english_meaning: An alphabetical list of names, subjects, etc., or a numerical scale used to compare data.
21.example: The consumer price index helps measure inflation over time.

21.english_meaning: Conclusions reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning.
21.example: We can draw logical inferences from the data presented in the report.

21.english_meaning: To seek information or advice from someone, or refer to a source like a book or report.
21.example: You should consult a doctor if the fever persists.

21.english_meaning: A detailed account or statement about a specific matter, often based on investigation.
21.example: The committee submitted its report on environmental pollution yesterday.

21.english_meaning: An individual or collaborative enterprise that is carefully planned to achieve a particular aim.

21.english_meaning: A thing that a person does or takes part in.

21.english_meaning: A number of connected items or names written or printed consecutively.

21.english_meaning: To estimate, measure, or note the similarity or dissimilarity between two or more items.
21.example: It is interesting to compare the climates of different regions.

22.english_meaning: The process of extracting stone, sand, or other building materials from the earth.

22.english_meaning: Workers engaged in primary activities due to the outdoor nature of their work.

23.english_meaning: Perform a series of actions on something in order to change or preserve it.

23.example: The bark of certain trees is used to extract quinine for treating malaria.

80.hindi_meaning: समुच्चरेखा जुताई; मृदा और जल संरक्षण के लिए ढलानों पर कंटूर रेखाओं के साथ की जाने वाली जुताई।

80.english_meaning: A method of farming adopted in regions of inadequate rainfall by conserving moisture.
80.hindi_meaning: शुष्क कृषि; अपर्याप्त वर्षा वाले क्षेत्रों में नमी संरक्षित करके खेती करने की विधि।
80.example: Millets are commonly grown using dry farming techniques in arid zones.

80.english_meaning: The branch of geography dealing with environmental influences on human economic activity.
80.hindi_meaning: आर्थिक भूगोल; भूगोल की वह शाखा जो मानवीय आर्थिक गतिविधियों पर पर्यावरण के प्रभाव का अध्ययन करती है।
80.example: Economic geography explains why certain industries are located in specific regions.

80.english_meaning: Surroundings or conditions under which a person or thing exists and develops.
80.hindi_meaning: पर्यावरण; आसपास की वे स्थितियां या परिवेश जिसमें कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु रहती और विकसित होती है।
80.example: We must protect our environment from pollution and deforestation.

80.english_meaning: Farming in which the amount of capital and labour applied to a given area is relatively small.
80.hindi_meaning: विस्तृत कृषि; वह खेती जिसमें एक बड़े क्षेत्र पर अपेक्षाकृत कम पूंजी और श्रम का उपयोग किया जाता है।

80.english_meaning: An extensive stretch of deep water where vessels can anchor securely.

80.english_meaning: Farming using large amounts of capital and labour per unit area to obtain high yield.

80.english_meaning: A very large city or major center of population, commerce, and culture.

81.english_meaning: The seasonal movement of herdsmen and their livestock between mountain pastures and lowland areas.

84.english_meaning: Passed on from one place, person, or thing to another.

84.english_meaning: Relating to machinery, engines, or physical processes.

84.english_meaning: Permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

84.english_meaning: Not satisfactory or permissible.

84.english_meaning: The grounds and buildings of a university or institution.

89.english_meaning: The process of growing, changing, or creating something over time.
89.example: Textbook development requires careful research and editing.

89.english_meaning: An institution of higher education and research which grants academic degrees.
89.example: She graduated from the University of Calcutta.

89.english_meaning: An educational institution or establishment providing higher education or specialized training.
89.example: He studies at a government post-graduate college.

89.english_meaning: An organization founded for a religious, educational, professional, or social purpose.
89.example: NCERT is a premier educational institution in India.

89.english_meaning: A specialist in a particular branch of study, especially the humanities.
89.example: Distinguished scholars contributed to the making of these books.

89.english_meaning: The organization of different elements to enable them to work together effectively.
89.example: The project was successful due to good coordination among members.

90.english_meaning: An act of expressing gratitude or recognizing the contribution of someone.
90.example: The book begins with an acknowledgement of all the people who helped in its creation.

90.english_meaning: An advisory or administrative body of people officially constituted.
90.example: The National Council of Educational Research and Training published the textbook.

90.english_meaning: The process of developing or being created over a period.
90.example: Teachers played an important role in the development of this curriculum.

90.english_meaning: The official official formal authorization or verification of a document or map.
90.example: The map required official certification before it could be printed in the book.

90.english_meaning: A picture, photograph, or diagram used to explain a book or text.
90.example: Every chapter contains a helpful illustration to explain the geographical features.

90.english_meaning: A person who operates equipment or a machine, such as a computer.
90.example: The DTP operator formatted the pages neatly for printing.

90.english_meaning: The exclusive legal right to print, publish, or perform material.
90.example: The map is protected under Government of India copyright laws.

90.english_meaning: Relating to the land or waters under the jurisdiction of a state or country.
90.example: The territorial waters of India extend up to twelve nautical miles into the sea.

90.english_meaning: Associated with sailors, navigation, or the sea.
90.example: Distances at sea are measured in nautical miles.

90.english_meaning: Relating to the running of a business, organization, or government.
90.example: Chandigarh serves as the administrative headquarters for two states.

90.english_meaning: The main offices of an organization or governing body.
90.example: The administrative headquarters of the regional authority are located in the city.

90.english_meaning: Existing or carried on between different states.
90.example: Interstate boundaries define the legal limits between neighboring states.

90.english_meaning: The action of organizing something again or differently, usually political boundaries.
90.example: The North-Eastern Areas Reorganisation Act changed the political map of the region.

90.english_meaning: Checked or proven to be accurate, correct, or true.
90.example: Some border alignments have not yet been formally verified by the concerned governments.

90.english_meaning: Coming from or located on the outside.
90.example: The external boundaries of the country are clearly marked on the master copy.

90.english_meaning: The outline or boundary of a coast where the land meets the sea.
90.example: India has a long and varied coastline along the Indian Ocean.

90.english_meaning: Relates to or is of importance to a particular person or group.
90.example: These matters are evaluated by the governments concerned.

90.english_meaning: The preparation and issuing of a book or journal for public sale.
90.example: The Publication Department of NCERT handles the printing of school books.

90.english_meaning: The action of explaining or understanding the meaning of something.
90.example: The boundary lines are drawn based on legal interpretation of the act.

90.english_meaning: The state or fact of having a duty to deal with something.
90.example: The publisher takes responsibility for the correctness of internal details.

91.english_meaning: A short introduction to a book, typically written by someone other than the author.
91.example: The principal wrote an inspiring foreword for the school magazine.

91.english_meaning: The branch of geography dealing with how human activity affects or is influenced by the earth's surface.
91.example: Human geography studies the distribution of populations across different continents.

91.english_meaning: The basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.
91.example: We must understand the true nature of ecological problems.

91.english_meaning: The extent of the area or subject matter that something deals with or to which it is relevant.
91.example: The scope of this research includes economic and social factors.

91.english_meaning: All the inhabitants of a particular town, area, or country.
91.example: India has a very large and youthful population.

91.english_meaning: The way in which something is shared out among a group or spread over an area.
91.example: The uneven distribution of rainfall affects agricultural production.

91.english_meaning: The quantity of people or things in a given area or space.
91.example: Urban areas usually have a high population density.

91.english_meaning: The process of increasing in amount, value, or size.
91.example: Economic growth is essential for reducing poverty.

91.english_meaning: A process of enlarging people's choices and raising their level of well-being and education.
91.example: Health and education are key indicators of human development.

91.english_meaning: Economic activities that involve the extraction and harvesting of natural resources.
91.example: Agriculture and mining are classic examples of primary activities.

91.english_meaning: Economic activities that process raw materials into finished goods.
91.example: Manufacturing industries belong to secondary activities.

91.english_meaning: Economic activities that provide commercial services to businesses and consumers.
91.example: Retail trade, transport, and banking are tertiary activities.

91.english_meaning: Activities involving information, research, and high-level knowledge services.
91.example: Software development and scientific research are quaternary activities.

91.english_meaning: The action of moving people or things from one place to another.
91.example: Public transport helps reduce traffic congestion in big cities.

91.english_meaning: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.
91.example: Modern communication technology connects people globally in seconds.

91.english_meaning: The exchange of capital, goods, and services across international borders or territories.
91.example: International trade plays a vital role in boosting a country's economy.

91.english_meaning: A section at the end of a book or document that gives extra information.
91.example: Important statistical data is provided in Appendix I of the textbook.

91.english_meaning: An alphabetical list of terms or words relating to a specific subject with explanations.
91.example: You can check the glossary at the back of the book for difficult terms.

91.english_meaning: An edition of a printed work that is issued again without substantial changes.
91.example: This textbook is a revised reprint for the academic session.

91.english_meaning: A distinct section or module of a course of study or textbook.
91.example: Unit I covers the fundamental concepts of human geography.
